about: Output with LEVEL, on the rgb8 profile (types/0x0020-output.md §5.1–§5.3; zadania/devices/DEVICE-03.md): Level is the only true state and OnOff follows it; LastLevel is never zero and On after Off lights at it; MinLevel/MaxLevel bound SetLevel and Step, and Step never crosses zero; a transition is linear, reported only at its start (Transitioning = 1) and end (the level reached, Transitioning = 0); a new command interrupts it from where it is, Stop freezes it; On, Off and Toggle fade over DefaultFadeTime, transition 0xFFFF means DefaultFadeTime too. ReportMinGap = 200, so a round inside the gap is held back and goes out at the tick with the CURRENT values. `light` is what the library last handed the device's drive function: [level, r, g, b, w] — intent, before the device's own brightness curve. LastLevel and the colour are stored together, 5 s after the last change of either — not at each.

steps.note: PowerOnBehaviour OFF: dark, in the default colour (white)
read Level
SetLevel(500, 0): at once, OnOff and Level in one round
Off: fades over DefaultFadeTime (400 ms); only Transitioning at the start
half-way: 250, nothing reported
the end: OnOff, Level and Transitioning in one round
LastLevel kept the level Off took away
On: back to LastLevel; OnOff goes to 1 at the start — Level is above zero from the first step
Stop a quarter of the way: 125; the round is inside ReportMinGap — held back
the gap has passed: the level it stopped at
Step +2000: saturates at MaxLevel
Step -5000: saturates at MinLevel, never through zero
SetLevel(5): below MinLevel is MinLevel — already there, nothing to report
SetLevel(1001): out of range
SetLevel without its transition: a wrong length
MinLevel 0: out of the type's range
Level is read-only
no PULSE here: UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE, not UNSUPPORTED_ELEMENT
SetLevel(0, 0): the same as Off, at once; LastLevel takes 10
Toggle from dark: On, fading to LastLevel
SetLevel(800, 0xFFFF) a quarter of the way: interrupts, starts again from 2 over DefaultFadeTime — still transitioning, nothing new to report
the end of the second transition
LastLevel took the target
SetLevel(0, 0)
Step down when dark: nothing to dim, nothing happens
Step up when dark: lights at the step, at least MinLevel
LastLevel not stored yet — 5 s from the last change
now
Features: LEVEL | COLOR_RGB
AutoOffTime = 1 s; lit since 3400, so past its time at once: Off over DefaultFadeTime
fading ONCE — not started again at every tick
